person.name: V. N. Srivatsan
person.bio: Mr. V. N. Srivatsan has approximately 34 years of overall professional experience, including around 25 years in the BFSI sector and close to 10 years of direct experience in Compliance and Regulatory Inspection. Prior to joining the Bank, he served as Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank Limited. He holds a Post Graduate degree in Business Administration from PSG College of Technology and a Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) from Sri Venkateshwara University. He has previously led Retail Banking Compliance and Regulatory Inspection for more than 8 years. His responsibilities have included oversight of regulatory compliance, handling regulatory inspections, designing and implementing compliance frameworks and policies, and working closely with senior management, the Audit Committee, the Board and regulators. Mr. V. N. Srivatsan’s experience is strongly aligned with the requirements of the Chief Compliance Officer role.
